headline: Capital One India picks IBM veteran Pooja Ranjan to head HR
summary: Capital One India has appointed former IBM executive Pooja Ranjan as its new Head of Human Resources. Bringing over two decades of enterprise HR and workforce transformation experience, Ranjan will oversee talent strategy, leadership planning, and organizational development. In her new role, she aims to foster a culture that attracts top data scientists, engineers, and technology leaders to solve complex financial challenges.

headline: KPMG elevates Saikat Halder to director–TA
summary: KPMG has promoted Saikat Halder to Director of Talent Acquisition, elevating him from his former role as Senior Associate Director within the KPMG Global Services team. Halder brings over 15 years of HR and recruitment experience to the position, including prior talent acquisition roles at Atlassian, PwC, and Ma Foi. In his new capacity, he will focus on talent acquisition leadership, process improvement, and strategic partnerships across business lines.
